golden.exempt: A framework is not a country: this pack carries statements and nothing else — no chart of accounts, no journal, no tax and no currency — so no company can be installed on it and there is no year of books to replay. Its statement lines are proved where they are reachable, through a chart that names no statement of its own and falls back here.

sources: IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard (2015), section 4 — Statement of Financial Position
IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard (2015), section 5 — Statement of Comprehensive Income
